force_app_update.description: Lowest app version allowed (versionName, e.g. 1.0.1). Apps below it show a modal that can't be closed until they update. 1.0.0 = nobody is forced.

force_app_update_message.description: Optional modal text. Empty = the built-in message.

force_app_update_url.description: Optional link for the Update button. Empty = this app's Google Play page.
